# dev-instance

Run the current worktree as a production-shaped local dev instance — core, Slack, web UI, admin, portal, on a real Pi LLM + Postgres — reachable in Slack as your own bot. Each developer uses their own set of Slack apps from their own machine's pool store, so many worktrees (yours and a teammate's) can run reachable at once without colliding. Use when asked to /dev-instance, "spin this up so I can QA it in Slack", or "let me test your branch end to end".

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$dev-instance`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
